_note: Authored opening sentences for the description sweep (#1404), batch 15.

proposals.current: Distributes data across the output slots, so a certain percentage of data is in the specified slot. Please note that negative weights will be replaced by zero. The output data is unique, meaning that there will be no overlaps between different slots. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Splits the incoming data randomly, sending a certain percentage of it to the specified output slot. Negative weights are replaced by zero, and each data item goes to only one slot (no overlaps). The data is grouped by annotations; to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.

proposals.current: Merges the incoming data into merging iteration steps. Only outputs the items according to the index range. You can use this to remove duplicates. Annotations are not modified (merged annotations are not copied into the output). This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: This slicer merges the incoming data into merging iteration steps, outputting only the items within the index range. You can use this to remove duplicates. Annotations are not modified (merged annotations are not copied into the output). This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.

proposals.current: Copies the annotations of a data table into the table itself
proposals.proposed: Pushes the annotations of a data table into the table itself.

proposals.current: Extracts data stored in the input slot into the output. If multiple tables are supplied, the rows are merged.
proposals.proposed: Unpacks a data table, extracting the data items stored in its rows into the output. If multiple tables are supplied, the rows are merged.

proposals.current: Pass multiple inputs through this node to check if iteration steps are correctly created and filter out incomplete steps. This node is designed for creating iteration steps where multiple data items can be assigned to an iteration step input slot. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Checks that iteration steps with multiple data items per input slot are created correctly, filtering out incomplete steps. This node is designed for creating iteration steps where multiple data items can be assigned to an input slot. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.

proposals.current: Cancels the current run if data is processed. Use this node to inform users about unwanted conditions in your pipeline.
proposals.proposed: Crashes the current run as soon as any data is processed. Use this node to inform users about unwanted conditions in your pipeline.

proposals.current: Annotates the incoming data tables with text and data annotations from inside the data table
proposals.proposed: Pulls text and data annotations from inside each data table and exposes them on the table's output.

proposals.current: Distributes data across the output slots, so a each of the slot is provided with the number of data as specified. The output data is unique, meaning that there will be no overlaps between different slots. If there is not enough data available, the slots with the lower order (left/top) are preferred. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Splits the incoming data randomly, giving each output slot the specified count of data items. Each data item goes to only one slot (no overlaps); if there is not enough data, the slots with the lower order (left/top) are preferred. The data is grouped by annotations; to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.

proposals.current: Creates a iteration step of the reference and data inputs. If the data is missing for a reference, it is extracted from the items in the placeholder slot. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one or multiple data item per slot. If items are missing, they will be generated according to this node's generator function. Otherwise data will be passed through.
proposals.proposed: Creates an iteration step from the reference and data inputs, where a placeholder is used for any reference whose data is missing. If the data is missing for a reference, it is extracted from the items in the placeholder slot. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one or multiple data item per slot. If items are missing, they will be generated according to this node's generator function. Otherwise data will be passed through.

proposals.current: Extracts a slot output folder from a JIPipe output. Use the 'Set output slot' button to select the correct parameters.
proposals.proposed: Gets the output folder of a specific slot from a JIPipe output. Use the 'Set output slot' button to select the correct parameters.

proposals.current: Stores the incoming paths into parameters. This node supports path and string parameters. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Stores the incoming paths as JIPipe project parameters. This node supports path and string parameters. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.

proposals.current: Executes a process. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Runs an external process once per data item (the iterating variant). This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.

proposals.current: Executes a process. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Runs an external process once per group of data items (the merging variant). This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
